title: [ALAppExtensions #30221][Event Request] table 12137 "Purch. Withh. Contribution"
summary: Two integration events added to the Purch. Withh. Contribution table enable partners to override the INPS calculation or populate custom fields during record creation without affecting the default behavior.
key_points: OnValorizzaINPSOnBeforeCalcAssoggettato event with IsHandled guard allows partners to replace the Assoggettato calculation
OnCreateRecordOnBeforeInsertPurchWithhContribution event fires before insert to let subscribers populate custom fields
IsHandled defaults to false so standard calculation runs unchanged unless explicitly overridden
No schema or data changes; low risk extension points
quote: Adds two integration events to table 12137 "Purch. Withh. Contribution"
